about_the_game:
YOUR HOME IS NO LONGER SAFE

"Dad?" Little Lawrence wakes up alone in the middle of the night, but the house is not empty. A strange event takes place tonight, and grotesque figures plucked from a nightmare haunt the hallways, turning his warm home into a place where he is no longer safe. A classic survival horror where stealth is your only defense.

STAY HIDDEN AND SURVIVE

You are defenseless. You cannot fight. Your only option is to run and hide. Use wardrobes, boxes, and any corner to stay out of sight of whatever is hunting Lawrence. Direct confrontation is lethal. But be careful: once hidden, Lawrence will panic, and you must help him stay calm. If you fail, you will be discovered.

REVEAL THE SECRETS

Discover the secrets of a home you no longer recognize, unveil the mystery of the ritual that caused it all, solve the puzzles blocking your path, and find your missing father.

VISUAL STYLE:

  • A haunting Gothic art style inspired by the works of Tim Burton.

  • Hand-painted 2D cinematics for jumpscares, death sequences, and narrative moments, inspired by the aesthetic of the analog horror series The Walten Files.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes scenes that hint at blood and violence throughout the story, both in the cinematic scenes and in the gameplay.
